evidence.reason: The combined auxiliary loss did not improve actual point selection. Isolate the coordinate term against flat CE first; this is a hypothesis, not an identified cause. Kind-only and the interaction remain unmeasured.

source.label: Unchanged A512 hard index and teacher kind derived from that existing label; A1024 audit only

model.kindMask: Read-only first three one-hot candidate features; verify against stored legal keys before fit; no key/teacher input to forward

objective.point: Original native cross_entropy(s[G_point], local_y) only when the original A512 target kind is single-cell; scalar zero otherwise
objective.normalization: Mean per observation in the actual batch (including point-term zeros); final batch uses actual length. No class reweighting, oversampling or separate point-only denominator
objective.numeric: CPU float32; all CE terms use original torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy, with logsumexp minus log(n_g) for kind logits; mathematical identities do not authorize a differently rounded flat-loss rewrite; full legal mask; finite losses/gradients required
objective.absentKinds: Do not evaluate a conditional CE when target is not point, including when no point candidates exist. For a point target, missing target/point group is STOP; singleton group gives zero conditional loss.
objective.kindTerm: No kind objective or kind-head routing. Preserve original full-list CE, which still contains competition between kinds.
objective.gradientScope: The additional point loss has zero derivative on non-point logits of this observation; shared network parameters can still affect every kind on other observations. It is not a point-only dataset reweighting.

inference.selection: Unchanged raw full-list s argmax, first original index tie; no teacher-kind or balanced-kind routing
inference.probabilities: Global sum-softmax kind mass and auxiliary log-mean-exp kind softmax are different diagnostics; never substitute for actual selection

training.order: Identical cold initialization and explicit train shuffle audit; no pretrained warm start
training.selection: Per arm highest original A512 dev actual top1, earliest epoch tie; no point/oracle/NLL-based reselection
training.baselineControl: Before candidate training: exact original spatial and completed flat control history, shuffle, epoch11, logical weights, train/dev full logits and prediction scores. No warm start; STOP on any drift.
training.initialControl: Two fresh same-seed original spatial models, one full-list call each per 428 observations; logits and initial logical weights exact
training.candidateControl: No comparison of candidate weights to combined arm is required: objectives differ. The completed combined arm is historical context, not a concurrently retrained third arm.

forwardBudget.scope: Only successful approved future run. Count actual calls before each top-level forward, including train/dev and chunk32 graph; no extra warmups/telemetry/common-only calls
forwardBudget.failure: STOP with partial ledger/output preserved; no silent restart, retry or extra epoch/seed/weight sweep

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch; no new dependencies, install, GPU or service
resources.scope: Owned preflight then baseline then candidate; child timer covers preparation/load/train/eval, total owner timer covers orchestration. RSS samples at load/batch-before-after/eval; not instantaneous peak

coordinateMechanism.claim: Coordinate screening only. Actual point, kind selection and original four gates must still be reported separately.

screening.metrics: For train/dev: actual top1/point/reroll, teacher-point selected-kind recall and confusion, oracle point top1/top5/rank/NLL, full NLL/errors, per-fixture and teacher-kind/family/completeness/phase/legal-kind denominators, paired gain/regression vs concurrent baseline and stored original. Report each loss separately
screening.jointPartition: For teacher-point observations, report bothCorrect/kindOnly/coordinateOnly/neither per arm/split; verify bothCorrect equals actual point correctness. Report paired recovery/regression at full action, kind and oracle-coordinate levels with fixed denominators.
screening.decision: Report technical compliance, all-four-gate screening and coordinate mechanism separately. Do not relax the existing four gates, select another epoch by point/oracle/NLL, infer an interaction, or adopt a model.
screening.missingDenominator: STOP if original split counts, action kinds, teacher labels or full candidate order drift

boundaries.publicVerification: Existing Node stdlib only: static schema, published aggregate hashes and synthetic double-precision scalar identities/finite differences. No Python/torch import, model, checkpoint or logits read.
boundaries.futurePublication: This authorization covers the proposal/validator/README only; future execution and its publication require explicit scope.
boundaries.implementation: Training runner is not implemented by this proposal. Do not pass this JSON to the completed combined-loss CLI or edit its frozen execution config.
boundaries.interpretation: Known-dev, single-seed, selected-epoch screening. Only point-only versus concurrent flat is the planned contrast. No kind-only measurement, factorial interaction estimate, held-out generalization, survival or product superiority claim.
